question: Is the focused test plus prior failing CI sufficient for this test-only stabilization, or must this head show an after-fix full-shard or deliberately contaminated-registry pass before merge?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but repository policy treats real behavior proof as a merge gate and the protected label reserves proof sufficiency for human judgment.

options.title: Require exact-scenario proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or a linked run showing this head passing the full gateway shard or a controlled registry containing unrelated stale contexts.

options.title: Accept focused evidence
options.body: Treat the focused 100-test pass and prior deterministic CI failure as sufficient because the patch changes only the test assertion and leaves runtime behavior untouched.

recommendation.title: Require exact-scenario proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or a linked run showing this head passing the full gateway shard or a controlled registry containing unrelated stale contexts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest adjacent gateway test-stabilization history and is already connected to the current change.
